about.title: Dunsmuir Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: In a place the size of Dunsmuir, a death is never anonymous. Roughly 1,582 people live here, so a loss tied to I-5, Dunsmuir Avenue or Castle Avenue is felt at the post office, the school and the diner within days. Public records show the city closed 2025 with no traffic deaths, and that matters. Still, wrongful death claims reach beyond the highway. A fatal fall at a rental property, a medication error, an unguarded worksite, or a collision on the I-5 southbound lanes all raise one legal question: did someone else's carelessness end a life? California allows certain surviving family members to bring a civil claim, entirely separate from anything a prosecutor may or may not do. LawProactive is here to make the first step lighter. Tell us what happened, and we connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters in Siskiyou County. That attorney reviews the facts, explains who has standing, and works on contingency if the case moves forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Dunsmuir Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing, with a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with sorts this out early so the right people are protected.

items.title: The two-year clock, watched closely
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected sooner keeps options open.

items.title: Every loss accounted for
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance are all recoverable under California law. Your attorney builds the claim around your family's real losses, not a formula.

items.question: My family member was killed on I-5 near Dunsmuir. Does it matter that we live somewhere else?
items.answer: Not for your right to bring a claim. Wrongful death cases arising from a crash in Siskiyou County can generally be filed here regardless of where the family lives. The independent attorney you're connected with can explain venue and handle the local logistics so you don't have to travel back and forth.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from any criminal case. Waiting for a criminal outcome can actually eat into the two-year filing deadline, so it's worth speaking with an attorney now.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge us anything?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery.
